rate_policy: Nonnegative delta between consecutive on-time collector observations of the same NFD instance, divided by actual source sampling elapsed time. First observation and resets remain missing.
missing_policy: No source audit, future value or unobserved telemetry is used for imputation.
label_policy: Temporal attack-active label using workload ground-truth intervals evaluated at decision_ns.
model_readiness: Feature engineering candidate only; graph topology, normalization, label QA and causal tests remain gates.
